# Houseki banner

[houseki-banner.jpg](houseki-banner.jpg) is the README banner and social-preview export at 1280 × 640 pixels.
[houseki-banner.png](houseki-banner.png) retains the original 1774 × 887 generated artwork. The JPEG is a proportional
export of that artwork with no crop or added content. Both files have opaque backgrounds.

The banner was created with Codex's built-in image generation on 2026-10-18. The prompt is retained below so the visual
direction and exact copy can be reproduced. No existing logo or third-party reference image was supplied.

GitHub's [social-preview guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/customizing-your-repositorys-social-media-preview)
recommends 1280 × 640 pixels and a file under 1 MB. The JPEG meets both. To use it for repository links, upload
`houseki-banner.jpg` under the repository's **Settings → Social preview**. Embedding it in the README does not configure
that setting.

## Generation prompt

```text
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: GitHub repository README hero and social preview banner for Houseki, an experimental Rust project for private value and cryptographic proofs.
Primary request: Design a polished, distinctive wide brand banner with a faceted jade gemstone and clean typography. One complete landscape image, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 1600 by 800. Fully opaque background.
Scene/backdrop: Deep warm charcoal, very subtle fine grain and faint precise geometric construction lines. Restrained, spacious, editorial technical identity.
Subject: One striking translucent emerald and pale-jade crystal, sharp architectural facets, physically believable internal refraction, tiny bright edges. Positioned in the right half. A few thin technical lines echo the facets, quietly suggesting verification rather than a network diagram.
Composition/framing: Broad quiet left half for large highly legible typography. All words and the crystal remain inside generous 8 percent safe margins, so the design works as a README banner and social card. Balanced asymmetrical composition, no card frame or mockup.
Lighting/mood: Elegant dramatic studio light. Muted emerald glow and crisp silver-white highlights. Confident and precise.
Text (verbatim): Main large title "Houseki". Below in a smaller clear sans serif: "Native foundations for private value." A restrained small label near the lower left: "RUST / CRYPTOGRAPHY / PROOFS".
Typography: Beautiful contemporary sans serif, deliberate kerning, light ivory main title, muted sage subtitle. Render all text exactly, exceptionally readable.
Constraints: This is an original repository brand image, not an existing company logo. No extra copy. No coins, currency symbols, padlocks, shields, mascots, people, hands, rockets, fake badges, audit claims, screenshot chrome, watermark, or stock-photo appearance. Avoid neon cyberpunk colors and visual clutter.
```
